name: amicus
description: Audit a quantitative social-science paper against 14 methods checklists (iv, did, rdd, conjoint, survey_exp, field_exp, text, matching, mediation, multilevel, panel, synth, measurement, hte) and a universal checklist, and write AMICUS_REPORT.md

author.name: Tak-Huen Chau and Andrew T. Little

interface.shortDescription: Check a paper against methods checklists
interface.longDescription: AMICUS works through a checklist for each research design your paper uses, and through a universal checklist, and gives suggestions to improve its technical soundness. Each main suggestion quotes the passage of your paper it concerns, or says the paper is silent, and cites the methods source and page. It writes AMICUS_REPORT.md next to the paper.
interface.developerName: Tak-Huen Chau and Andrew T. Little
